title: CoPyro: Feeding Copy Proposals to Parallel Drafters
abstract: arXiv:2611.27217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language generation by letting a target model verify several draft tokens in one forward pass. Earlier neural drafters such as EAGLE extend each candidate sequence one token at a time. Recent work has turned to parallel drafters such as DFlash, which predict a whole block at once. Another approach uses n-gram retrieval to find an earlier occurrence of the current context suffix and copy the tokens that followed it directly into the draft. We introduce CoPyro, which feeds these copied tokens into a parallel drafter in place of masks. The drafter learns from context which tokens to keep and which to revise as it predicts the block in its usual forward pass. Across eight benchmarks on Qwen3-4B, CoPyro improves overall acceptance length for all four parallel drafters tested, with gains of 2.19-5.08% when trained on 100K samples. With DFlash trained on 710K samples, overall gains range from 1.08% to 2.00% acro

translated_title: CoPyro：将复制提议馈送至并行起草器
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过让目标模型在单次前向传播中验证多个草稿 token 来加速语言生成。早期的神经起草器（如 EAGLE）每次将候选序列扩展一个 token；近期的研究转向并行起草器（如 DFlash），它们可以一次性预测整个 token 块。另一种方法则利用 n-gram 检索，查找当前上下文后缀此前出现的位置，并将其后跟随的 token 直接复制到草稿中。我们提出 CoPyro，将这些复制的 token 取代掩码馈送至并行起草器，起草器在常规的单次前向传播中预测块的同时，从上下文中学习哪些 token 应保留、哪些应修改。在 Qwen3-4B 的八个基准测试上，CoPyro 提升了所测试的全部四个并行起草器的整体接受长度，在 10 万样本训练下增益为 2.19%–5.08%；使用在 71 万样本上训练的 DFlash 时，整体增益范围为 1.08% 到 2.00%。
tldr: CoPyro 将 n-gram 检索复制得到的 token 取代掩码馈入并行起草器，使其在单次前向传播中学会保留或修改这些 token，从而在 Qwen3-4B 的八个基准上为所有测试的并行起草器显著提升推测解码的接受长度。
en_tdlr: CoPyro feeds n-gram-retrieved copied tokens to parallel drafters in place of masks, letting them learn which tokens to keep or revise in a single forward pass, which improves overall acceptance length for all tested parallel drafters on Qwen3-4B across eight benchmarks.
